about: The one new survivor. A clone of a vanilla body keeps hurtboxes, item displays and networking; Mario replaces its look and movement.

rows.name: Mario
rows.subtitle: Super Star Plumber
rows.description:
Mario plays with his real Super Mario 64 moveset, read from your own ROM.<color=#CCD3E0>

< ! > Jump (A) three times in a row for a triple jump; crouch (Z) and jump for a long jump or backflip.

< ! > Punch (B) three times for a punch-punch-kick combo. Run and press B to dive.

< ! > Ground pound (Z in the air) hits everything around where you land.

< ! > Land on an enemy's head to stomp it and bounce.

< ! > Damage items make every hit stronger, and on-hit items trigger from punches, kicks and stomps.</color>
rows.outro: ..and so he left, with a Power Star and a story nobody in the Mushroom Kingdom will believe.
